subject: Optimize libdivide_128_div_64_to_64() using __uint128_t
perf_evidence: Commit replaces the portable long-division implementation with native unsigned-128 arithmetic.
change_summary: Selects __uint128_t for 128-by-64 division on compilers that support it.

units.name: raw 128-by-64 quotient and remainder with arbitrary inputs
units.evidence: Alive2 gives counterexamples outside the helper's quotient-fit domain for raw quotient/remainder.

units.name: 128-by-64 helper under its documented quotient-fit contract
units.evidence: Both preconditioned quotient and remainder checks time out in both directions.

units.name: public signed/unsigned 64-bit generator fields and generated division
units.evidence: All six generator/API targets time out in both directions.

notes: The raw counterexamples are not promoted to public API non-equivalence because they violate the helper's documented quotient-fit contract. The wrapper disables unchanged x86 inline assembly on both sides.
